# U.S. Census Bureau (Census.gov)

> The U.S. Census Bureau provides comprehensive demographic, economic, and population data through surveys, programs, and interactive tools to inform policy, business, and research decisions.

Census.gov serves as the official portal for accessing decennial census data, ongoing surveys like the American Community Survey (ACS), economic indicators, and historical census records. The site offers data access tools, educational resources, and support for survey participants and data users.

## Key Topics

- American Community Survey (ACS)
- 2020 Census
- 2030 Census
- Demographic Data
- Economic Indicators
- Population Data
- QuickFacts
- Data Tools
- Census Programs
- Survey Participation
- Business Statistics
- Decennial Census
- Population Clock
- Census Records
- Data Access

## Core Data & Programs

- [Census Bureau Data and Maps](https://www.census.gov/data.html): Access demographic and economic data with visualizations and tutorials
- [American Community Survey (ACS)](https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/acs.html): Premier source for population, housing, and workforce demographic information
- [Our Surveys & Programs](https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys.html): Overview of Census Bureau surveys and programs for national statistics
- [Topics](https://www.census.gov/topics.html): Topic-based navigation to census data, news, and publications

## About & Information

- [About the U.S. Census Bureau](https://www.census.gov/about.html): Census Bureau mission, data quality standards, and government transparency policies
- [Census.gov | U.S. Census Bureau Homepage](https://www.census.gov): U.S. Census Bureau homepage providing access to population, economic data and census tools
- [Index A-Z](https://www.census.gov/about/index.html): Alphabetical index of Census Bureau statistics, products, and data resources
- [Census Partners](https://www.census.gov/partners.html): Census Bureau partnership opportunities and data sharing initiatives

## Support & Participation

- [Are You in a Survey? Help for Survey Participants](https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/surveyhelp.html): Survey participation guidance, verification info, and fraud prevention for respondents
- [Contact Us | U.S. Census Bureau](https://www.census.gov/about/contact-us.html): Census Bureau contact information, phone numbers, and customer service options

## Research & Resources

- [Research](https://www.census.gov/topics/research.html): Census Bureau research on survey methodology, AI, and machine learning applications
- [Library](https://www.census.gov/library.html): Multimedia library with audio, video, images, and census publications
- [Census Records and Family History](https://www.census.gov/about/history/census-records-family-history.html): Historical census records, genealogy resources, and age search services

## News & Education

- [Newsroom](https://www.census.gov/newsroom.html): Census Bureau press releases, news updates, and media resources
- [Statistics in Schools](https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/sis.html): K-12 educational program with classroom activities and statistics learning resources

## Optional

- [Census Careers](https://www.census.gov/about/census-careers.html): Job opportunities and hiring information at U.S. Census Bureau locations
